1.name: Unfinished Business
1.ov: Shaq and Allen Iverson reveal their game plan to rebuild Reebok's basketball reputation, from launching a new sneaker to recruiting young stars.

1.name: The Pivot
1.ov: A talented youngster emerges as a recruitment target for Shaq's team, while designs for the new shoe take shape ahead of the first prototypes.

1.name: The Future is Female
1.ov: With help from pro superstar Angel Reese, the team builds out its WNBA strategy. A heartfelt talk with Allen sets DiJonai Carrington up to grow her game.

1.name: Forge Your Own Path
1.ov: Shaq and the team miss out on signing a prime target. Embarking on his first recruiting trip, Shareef hopes to fill the gap with another player.

1.name: The Iverson Effect
1.ov: Shareef faces a tough choice about chasing his NBA dreams. With four weeks to go before the sneaker's debut, Allen reviews the latest prototypes.

1.name: Back in the Game
1.ov: The moment of truth arrives for Shaq and the team. With the entire basketball world watching, Angel Reese debuts Reebok's comeback sneaker.
